obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]
long_yaw = pen["long_axis_yaw"]
target_yaw = long_yaw + math.pi/2
cands = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
chosen = None
for c in cands:
    if c.get("source", "").startswith("geometry"):
        chosen = c
        break
if chosen is None:
    chosen = cands[0]
chosen["x"] = pen["center"][0]
chosen["y"] = pen["center"][1]
chosen["height"] = 0.006
chosen["yaw"] = target_yaw
chosen["squeeze_width"] = 0.0085

res = grasp(chosen)
if not res["holding_something"]:
    obs = observe()
    pen = obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]
    chosen["x"] = pen["center"][0]
    chosen["y"] = pen["center"][1]
    chosen["height"] = 0.009
    chosen["squeeze_width"] = 0.009
    res = grasp(chosen)

if res["holding_something"]:
    zone = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]
    carry_to(zone["center"][0], zone["center"][1], height=0.15)
    desired = zone["long_axis_yaw"] + math.atan2(zone["half_size"][1], zone["half_size"][0])
    current = chosen.get("object_long_axis_yaw", long_yaw)
    rotate_by(desired - current)
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
    check("blue_pen", "orange_tray")
